title: chrysanthellum procumbens
intro: Chrysanthellum procumbens, commonly known as False Daisy, is a flowering plant that belongs to the family Asteraceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Chrysanthellum procumbens are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which also aid in digestion and relieve menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
